resources.string: Synchronize and update hourly, daily and monthly history
Stable CI/release signing identity is configured for this build
Development/debug signing identity is used for this build
Physically validated: Live, Hour, Day and Month
Year/Billing is not exposed as a v2 history synchronization control.
This screen reads local product state only. It does not expose raw NFC traffic, raw M-Bus frames or private field traces.

Data leaves the app only after an explicit user action. Normal product data, backups and exports stay local until you deliberately save or share them. Diagnostic status shown in the app is local and does not include raw NFC or M-Bus traces.

The upstream project and its author are credited so the protocol-research lineage stays visible. Relevant behavior was also independently cross-checked against the open-source AxiomaQalcosonicW1NFCReaderAndroid project; no code from that project is bundled in this app.
